stemBlocks: The genetic condition represented by the shading is caused by the presence of at least one allele for the condition.
Which of the following are possible reasons why U has the condition?

1 The condition is dominant.
2 The sperm from T carried the allele for the condition.
3 A mutation is present in an egg of S.

assets.alt: Key: circle = female, square = male. Shaded individuals (T, U) have the condition.
